business_scope.primary_industry_name: Dedicated Offshore Software Engineering and Maintenance Hub

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (International Companies Registry under the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Port Vila)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English common law and French civil law heritage; codified statutes under the Laws of the Republic of Vanuatu (Revised Edition); Constitution of Vanuatu (1980) supreme; customary law recognized; appellate jurisdiction vested in the Court of Appeal, with historic final appeal to the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus — Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (in force 2020)
PICTA — Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (in force)
Interim Economic Partnership Agreement with the European Union (applied provisionally since 2017)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] as amended, including the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014 (beneficial ownership register for International Companies) and the 2019 amendments introducing economic-substance reporting for covered activities; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 10 of 2020; Financial Dealers (Licensing) Act [Cap 289]; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 249]; VFSC AML/CFT Directions and Beneficial Ownership Guidance; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit directives; APG (Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering) standards as applied by the VFSC.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the beneficial owner/shareholder's passport (national ID for domestic EEA/EU persons may be substituted)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the country of origin; attested copy certified by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — Vanuatu is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; the notarized copy must be legalized by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the document's country of origin and then by the Vanuatu High Commission/Embassy or Honorary Consul with competence for that country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized banker's reference / professional due-diligence letter addressed to the registered agent and VFSC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating bank or licensed financial institution at which the UBO maintains the account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via the same chain: notarization, country-of-origin Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication, then legalization by the competent Vanuatu diplomatic post or Honorary Consul; an original bank-stamped letter countersigned by the VFSC-licensed agent is accepted where no Vanuatu post exists

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certificate of Good Standing / police-clearance certificate for each director and UBO (where required by the agent's risk policy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Criminal-records authority or national police service of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization as above; documents must be translated into English or Bislama by a certified translator where issued in a non-English script

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn declaration of ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO declaration) and constitutional documents (Memorandum and Articles of Association) executed before a notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the client's jurisdiction of residence; countersigned by the licensed Vanuatu registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain where the IC Act or the registered agent's AML/CFT procedures require foreign-issued evidence; the VFSC accepts notarial execution evidenced by the agent's compliance attestation without a Vanuatu diplomatic post for sworn declarations

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Under the AML/CFT Act No. 10 of 2020 and VFSC Directions, the licensed registered agent must screen every shareholder, director, officer, and ultimate beneficial owner against the UN Consolidated List (UNSC Res. 1267/1988/2253 and successor regimes), OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Consolidated List, and domestic Vanuatu sanctions and asset-freezing measures administered by the VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit. Domestic and foreign PEP status must be assessed on a risk-sensitive basis; where any person is or has been a PEP within the preceding 12 months, enhanced due diligence (source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, senior-management approval, and increased monitoring) is mandatory. Screening must be re-run immediately before filing and on any UBO change; all identity, beneficial-ownership, and transaction-source records must be retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry, Port Vila (official portal: https://vfsc.vu); name reservation is filed electronically through the VFSC Registry e-lodgement interface exclusively by a licensed VFSC Registered Agent under ss. 4–5 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222] — there is no public self-service name reservation portal.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory language of the IC register is English (with French permissible for legal instruments under the Constitution). A proposed name must be in Latin-script characters; non-roman scripts (including Chinese, Korean, Arabic or Cyrillic characters) are rejected and must be transliterated into roman characters, with the transliteration confirmed by a certified translator and included in the name-clearance application. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.' or 'Société Anonyme' (SA) as required by s. 4(2) of the IC Act, and may not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing Vanuatu or foreign reserved name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: BANK / BANKER / BANKING — reserved; requires prior VFSC approval and a financial-dealers licence under the Financial Dealers (Licensing) Act [Cap 289]
INSURANCE / ASSURANCE / REINSURANCE — reserved; requires prior insurance licence from the VFSC
TRUST / TRUSTEE / TRUST COMPANY — reserved; requires prior VFSC approval as a licensed trustee
GOVERNMENT / MINISTRY / NATIONAL / ROYAL / OF THE REPUBLIC / SOVEREIGN — implies State patronage; requires prior ministerial consent
UNIVERSITY / INSTITUTE / CHAMBER / COUNCIL / ASSOCIATION — sensitive; requires prior approval of the relevant ministry where public sanction is implied
OFFSHORE / IBC / INTERNATIONAL COMPANY — descriptive tokens restricted by VFSC practice where the name would mislead as to licensing status
OBSCENE / IMMORAL OR CONTRARY-TO-PUBLIC-POLICY words — statutorily prohibited
Any name identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company, reserved name, or protected mark in the Vanuatu register
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Where the VFSC rejects a name reservation, the licensed registered agent may apply in writing to the Registry of International Companies for administrative reconsideration within 14 days of the rejection notice under ss. 4–5 of the IC Act [Cap 222]. The submission must include: (i) written reasons rebutting each ground of rejection; (ii) any prior-ministerial-approval letter or no-objection certificate obtained for sensitive tokens; (iii) consent of the affected earlier registrant where similarity was the ground; and (iv) two to three substitute names ranked in priority. A reserved-word refusal may be escalated to the Minister responsible for finance or the VFSC Board for ministerial consent. An extension of a pending reservation may be obtained by paying the VFSC extension fee before expiry, extending the reservation by a further 30 days. If administrative reconsideration and ministerial escalation fail, the applicant may seek judicial review in the Vanuatu Supreme Court within 30 days of the final administrative decision; foreign applicants must act through the registered agent with a notarized power of attorney included in the consular-legalization bundle.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a low-risk Offshore Development Center. An International Company is not required to maintain a business premise or any employees in Vanuatu; the statutory obligation under s. 6 of the IC Act [Cap 222] is satisfied by a registered office maintained at the office of a licensed registered agent in Port Vila where the statutory registers, minutes, and seal are kept. The ODC's actual software-engineering functions are performed remotely outside Vanuatu with no Vanuatu economic-substance or tax nexus; the registered agent's virtual-office arrangement is accepted provided that service-of-process, UBO register, and statutory records remain physically accessible at the agent's address and the AML/CFT risk categorization is maintained at 'Low_Risk_Standard'. The software-engineering activity is not a geographically mobile activity listed under Vanuatu's 2019 economic-substance rules (which target banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, and IP-type business), so no additional substance test is expected for the ODC beyond the standard registered-office and record-keeping requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — approximately 5% to 10% annual likelihood of an unannounced VFSC on-site inspection for a low-risk, non-licensed IC that maintains no physical presence in Vanuatu; inspections are ordinarily triggered by compliance red flags, adverse media, sanctions hits, or information requested by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, APG mutual-evaluation follow-up, or foreign exchange-of-information requests. A clean UBO file, timely government-fee payment, and agent-held statutory records materially reduce the practical inspection risk; however, the registered agent's Port Vila office is itself subject to VFSC/VGRA inspections and client files may be examined there without prior notice.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff — VFSC Fees Schedule (Government fees, revised annually)

Beneficial ownership (UBO) register initial filing and first-year maintenance filing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pro-rata first-year VFSC annual government maintenance fee (IC registration renewal to end of calendar year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff — VFSC annual fees schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a low-risk offshore IC

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (frequently bundled in the agent fee; quoted unbundled here)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a three-document notarial and consular-legalization chain

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per document bundle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Secure courier delivery of legalized originals and post-incorporation kit to the foreign principal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International courier (DHL/FedEx-type) + VFSC post-registration document dispatch
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for tracked international delivery

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992, consolidated as Cap. 222, ss. 16-25 (incorporation), s. 124 (tax exemption), and the International Companies Regulations 1993
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Application for Incorporation (VFSC Form IC-1), resulting in issuance of a Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; share capital may be denominated in any currency; no statutory escrow or capital deposit requirement exists for an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Memorandum and Articles of Association of VU_IC be and are hereby adopted as filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the office of its licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu; RESOLVED FURTHER that one ordinary share be allotted to the sole subscriber for the subscription price stated in the Memorandum and that such subscriber be registered as sole member; RESOLVED FURTHER that the subscriber be and is hereby appointed first director of the Company; RESOLVED FURTHER that the director be authorized to open bank accounts, appoint the registered agent, execute client agreements, and perform all lawful acts necessary for the establishment and operation of the offshore software development center.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry (via licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two to three preferred names to the VFSC through the licensed registered agent. The Registry will conduct a conflict check against the International Companies register and the domestic companies register. Name availability is confirmed in principle but a binding reservation is granted only upon formal filing of the incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the sole subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name is rejected or held to be undesirable, re-file an alternative name list within 5 business days; no appeal fee applies for a fresh name submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of the Constitution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English compliant with ss. 16-17 of the International Companies Act. The object clause must expressly cover software development, computer programming, IT consulting, and business process outsourcing services. The subscriber's signature must be notarized, and a director's consent declaration must be executed.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certificate of identity or bank reference for the subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC queries the objects clause or the form of the Articles, file an amended version within 14 days; the amendment is accepted without penalty if filed within the statutory correction window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the completed Application for Incorporation (Form IC-1) with the Memorandum and Articles, together with the declaration of the registered agent. Pay the official registration fee of USD 250 (authorized capital up to USD 10,000) and the annual maintenance fee of USD 100. Payment is accepted by wire transfer or through the registered agent's VFSC deposit account.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is refused or found defective, rectify the defect via a corrective filing with a supporting declaration within 30 days; failure to cure may result in striking off, which can be remedied by applying for reinstatement under the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Tax Exemption Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC and Ministry of Finance and Economic Management (MFEM)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation and registers the first director and registered office. Immediately thereafter, apply for the Tax Exemption Certificate under s. 124 of the International Companies Act to evidence zero tax on profits, dividends, capital gains, and income derived outside Vanuatu. Maintain the statutory registers at the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Tax Exemption Certificate is delayed, file a written request for expedited issuance with VFSC; any administrative error in the Certificate is corrected by VFSC upon submission of a rectification declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Registration and Municipal Business Licence (Conditional)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and Port Vila City Council
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For a foreign-owned International Company maintaining a physical office inside Vanuatu, file a foreign investment registration with VIPA and obtain a municipal Business Licence under the Business Licence Act. No sectoral license is mandated for ISIC 6202 software engineering activities; this step covers administrative and municipal revenue obligations only.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement for the physical office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VIPA or the Council queries the application, resubmit with clarifications within 10 business days; an adverse refusal may be appealed to the VIPA Board or the Council licensing committee respectively.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account and Payment Rail Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial banks in Vanuatu and approved payment service providers (Wise B2B, Payoneer)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the full corporate due diligence pack to the chosen bank or payment provider, including the Certificate of Incorporation, Tax Exemption Certificate, register of directors, and the first board resolution authorizing account opening. Complete source of funds declaration and beneficial ownership attestation. The ODC business model qualifies for the Low_Risk_Standard AML tier.
required_dossiers: First board resolution for account opening
Director identification and proof of address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If enhanced due diligence is triggered, provide a bank reference from the shareholder's home institution and a written economic substance declaration describing the software service contracts; re-submission cures most standard queries.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives; Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) for foreign investment registration
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable for ISIC 6202; municipal Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap. 253] is a revenue licence only, not a sectoral operating authorization

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Exempt/Registration: office-based software development and offshore development center activities do not trigger a mandatory Environmental Impact Assessment; only an Environmental Registration is required where the leased premises exceed 200 square meters or where uninterruptible power supply batteries and electronic waste are stored on site
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or industrial effluent generated; domestic sewage discharged to municipal sewer; electronic waste (WEEE) including decommissioned servers and UPS batteries must be logged and removed by a DEPC-licensed e-waste contractor; standby generator emissions must meet 55 dB(A) boundary noise limit and low-sulfur fuel requirements; non-hazardous solid waste to municipal collection

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Municipal building occupancy permit and structural load inspection for server rooms; fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire and Rescue Service covering extinguishers, smoke detection, and emergency exits; workplace health and safety compliance under the Employment Act [Cap. 160] including first-aid provisions and electrical safety inspection for office equipment

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Customs and Inland Revenue Department (CIRD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu; official portal: https://www.customsinland.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing a Vanuatu International Company (IC) must obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) from the CIRD. A company with a registered office and licensed agent in Vanuatu files the required incorporation documentation and obtains a TIN concurrently with company registration. If the IC intends to make taxable supplies above the VAT registration threshold, it must separately apply for VAT registration using Form VAT-001, providing the Certificate of Incorporation, memorandum and articles, agent confirmation, and expected revenue declarations. No capital gain or income tax registration is required for an IC because Vanuatu operates a territorial, zero-income-tax system for offshore entities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Vanuatu law, as Vanuatu does not impose an income tax on companies. The only relevant elective mechanism is voluntary VAT registration under the Value Added Tax Act, which may be chosen even when turnover is below the mandatory registration threshold. Hybrid mismatch elections are not applicable because there is no entity-level income tax in Vanuatu.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 10,000,000 (approximately USD 90,000) of annual taxable turnover in the customs territory of Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not mandate electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, or full-volume digital stamping. VAT returns are filed manually or through the CIRD's simplified e-filing facility. Customs export declarations are processed through the ASYCUDA World system, but there is no pre-clearance approval or live fiscal API integration for self-issued invoices for standard export transactions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A supply is zero-rated for Vanuatu VAT if goods are exported from Vanuatu directly under customs supervision or if services are supplied to a non-resident who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply and the services are wholly performed or used outside Vanuatu. For the Offshore Development Centre, qualifying software services and maintenance provided to overseas clients are treated as exported services where no local counterparty, local server, or domestic consumption exists.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical removal from Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate demonstrating receipt of consideration in a Vanuatu bank account or recognised offshore settlement account
Commercial Invoice and underlying service contract
Certificate of Origin (when required by the importing jurisdiction)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The CIRD may claw back any VAT input credit or zero-rated treatment if documentary substantiation is incomplete or falsified. Penalties include: VAT assessment at the standard 12.5% rate plus 100% late-payment penalty; civil penalties up to 150% of the evaded tax for reckless or fraudulent claims; cancellation of VAT registration and consequential loss of zero-rating privileges; and criminal fines up to VT 1,000,000 or imprisonment for up to five years for the knowing supply of false documents in an export zero-rating claim.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) - the statutory central bank and the delegated Exchange Control Administrator under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 77]. RBV licenses and supervises all commercial banks and deposit takers, administers the national payment and settlement system, and compiles balance-of-payments statistics. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) is the corporate registrar and regulator of International Companies (ICs) and non-bank financial institutions; it does not administer FX policy but issues the Certificate of Good Standing and the International Company license-records that banks require for onboarding.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is a managed-float currency pegged to a trade-weighted basket (USD, AUD, EUR, JPY) with RBV intervention. Current-account convertibility is unrestricted, and capital-account convertibility is de facto free for International Companies: Section 88 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] expressly exempts ICs and their non-resident owners from the Exchange Control Act. Non-resident shareholders may hold 100% equity, inject share capital, repatriate dividends, and repay shareholder loans without RBV prior approval. Vanuatu imposes no income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax on an IC, so dividend and liquidation remittances are tax-free. The practical remittance hurdles are documentary and correspondent-bank driven: the IC must maintain Good Standing with VFSC (annual return filed), keep an up-to-date register of beneficial owners for AML/CTF purposes, and give the settlement bank advance notice of large wires. There is no statutory administrative approval gate for an ODC receiving software-export service income.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no mandatory surrender, no statutory conversion timeline, and no prescribed conversion ratio for export proceeds. An ODC may retain 100% of its software-export receipts in VUV or in any foreign currency (USD, AUD, EUR, NZD) in onshore or offshore accounts. Only statistical-reporting obligations apply: licensed banks must submit balance-of-payments returns to RBV, and individual receipts above approximately VUV 1,000,000 (about USD 8,500) trigger the bank's internal FX declaration and source-of-funds verification workflow. The ODC should instruct foreign clients to include a payment narrative such as 'ISIC 6202 software maintenance services - invoice reference' so the bank auto-classifies the credit as service-export revenue rather than capital or remittance, which materially shortens clearing time.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account - USD multi-currency collection account and VUV local settlement account; optional Capital Escrow sub-ledger for client-milestone deposits
Operational Account - USD/EUR multi-currency clearing account; segregated Capital Escrow Account available for equity injection and intellectual-property escrow
Wholesale Operational Account (USD/VUV) for institutional-grade treasury flows; subject to minimum annual-turnover thresholds and credit review
Operational Account - VUV-only domestic account with limited multi-currency digital capability; suitable for payroll and local utilities only

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium as a tactical collection-only rail; Low as a primary treasury venue. Wise Business and Payoneer do not hold a license from the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu, do not support the VUV, and are not participants in the Vanuatu depositor-protection framework; funds held with them are e-money claims under the foreign license of the applicable receiving entity. Wise B2B will generally perform an enhanced manual review before onboarding a Vanuatu International Company and may reject files where the IC appears shell-like despite an active software-operations profile. Payoneer's standard terms do not prohibit ISIC 6202 service businesses, but Vanuatu-registered entities face periodic re-review. Legal constraints: neither rail can receive VUV, execute Vanuatu payroll, issue a capital-injection purpose code, or serve as evidence of local substance. Recommended architecture: use Wise B2B for client invoicing in USD/EUR/AUD from US/EU/AU counterparties; use Payoneer for marketplace payouts; cap aggregate EMI balances at USD 25,000; sweep all balances to the BSP or BRED onshore account at least weekly; and require all project clients above USD 10,000 per invoice to remit directly by SWIFT MT103 to the onshore account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No Vanuatu statute explicitly mandates physical director attendance for account opening; the practical mandate is set by bank internal AML policy under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Act (2022). BSP and BRED, the two highest-viability banks, require at least one authorized signatory - normally the General Manager, Country Manager, or Compliance Officer - to attend an in-person KYC interview at the Port Vila branch before account activation. Remote opening is permitted only with a tiered waiver package: (i) a notarized power of attorney appointing a Vanuatu-resident signatory; (ii) bank-reference letters from an existing long-standing bank of each 25%+ beneficial owner; (iii) three months of personal bank statements and certified passport copies for each material owner; (iv) a video-verified onboarding interview with the bank's compliance officer; and (v) a written undertaking from the registered agent to accept 24-hour transaction-notice obligations. For the ODC, the cleanest route is to appoint the local resident General Manager as a joint signatory, complete his or her interview in person, and keep all overseas principals as non-signatory directors subject to board-level oversight.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore IC profile with non-resident shareholders, nominal issued capital, and opaque beneficial-ownership register - bank underwriter flags 'shell-company pattern'.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation with apostille; VFSC Certificate of Good Standing issued within 14 days; updated Register of Directors and Shareholders; a signed beneficial-ownership declaration identifying each holder above 25%; certified passport copies of all material owners; the registered-agency agreement; the active software-service client contracts and a board-approved business plan; plus a legal-opinion letter from a licensed Vanuatu law firm confirming that the IC is not part of a shelf-bank or money-service arrangement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large initial equity injection arriving from a related-party personal account with SWIFT narrative 'capital' and no contemporaneous corporate documentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution authorizing the share issue; share subscription agreement; updated shareholders' register; the subscribing party's bank reference and three months of statements evidencing lawful accumulation of wealth; a source-of-wealth statement (salary, dividends, or business proceeds); and a pre-notification to the Relationship Manager 48 hours before settlement with the full wire header and FX reference code '5211-Equity-Direct-Investment'.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors with no Vanuatu footprint and no local payroll or office - bank risk model flags absence of physical substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease or sub-lease agreement for the Port Vila ODC office; recent utility invoice; local payroll records for the General Manager and any Vanuatu-based engineers; cloud-infrastructure and SaaS subscription contracts demonstrating the operating digital footprint; a notarized power of attorney naming the local joint signatory; and a board resolution confirming that all overseas directors will act only via the local signatory for banking operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Client or vendor payment counterparties located in FATF grey-listed, OFAC-sanctioned, or high-risk tax-transparency jurisdictions - screening alerts on the transaction flow.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved sanctions-screening and business-intelligence policy; a counterparty whitelist of project clients and vendors with jurisdiction-of-entity and bank-account-jurisdiction clauses in each contract; independent due-diligence reports on any counterparty located in a heightened-risk jurisdiction; the ODC's 12-month cash-flow forecast showing realistic service-export turnover; and a written compliance attestation that no funds will be received from or routed to prohibited persons or prohibited jurisdictions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound shareholder equity must be wired by SWIFT MT103 to the IC's USD Operational Account at BSP or BRED, with the payment narrative formatted as: 'EQUITY INJECTION - [IC legal name] - Board Resolution [date] - IMF BoP code 5211 (Direct Investment-Equity)'. The IC's bank must receive a pre-advice email from the Relationship Manager 24-48 hours before any wire above VUV 10,000,000 (about USD 85,000), including the full remitter details, the settlement currency, and the compliance pack. The verification pack to be delivered on or before settlement date: board resolution authorising the share issuance, signed share subscription agreement, updated register of shareholders, certified passport copies of the subscribing beneficial owner, and the bank reference of the remitting institution. Funds may arrive in VUV, USD, AUD, EUR, or NZD; if the settlement currency does not match the designated account currency, the bank converts at interbank mid-rate plus a spread of 0.5-1.0% unless a standing conversion instruction is lodged in advance. No RBV approval is required by virtue of the International Companies Act exemption, but the bank records the transaction on its RBV statistical return, so the IC must also file a corresponding share-issuance return with VFSC to keep the capital account reconciled.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Three clearing rails are deployed in parallel. (i) Domestic VUV clearing: payroll and local supplier payments settle through the domestic interbank system via settlement accounts at RBV - only an onshore Vanuatu bank account can execute this rail; the ODC should keep a VUV buffer equal to eight weeks of payroll to avoid forced daily FX conversion. (ii) International disbursements: SaaS subscriptions, cloud providers, overseas contractors, and dividend payments are executed by SWIFT MT103 for transfers above USD 5,000 and by SWIFT MT202/MT202 COV for agent-funding top-ups of the ODC's foreign-currency clearing accounts; every MT103 must carry a correct purpose narrative (royalty-free software services, professional fees, or dividend distribution) because erroneous narratives are the leading cause of correspondent-bank holds. (iii) Trade and performance instruments: UCP600-compliant commercial letters of credit may be opened for hardware or furniture procurement, while ISP98 standby letters of credit (SBLCs) should be requested from BSP or BRED in favour of large enterprise clients as milestone-based performance bonds; the SBLC facility must be pre-approved by the bank's credit committee. Small recurring subscriptions (e.g., cloud tools) may be paid via a BSP or BRED corporate Visa/Mastercard, capped at USD 15,000 per month to control card-FX spread leakage.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX outright forward (USD/VUV, AUD/VUV, EUR/VUV) up to 12 months, booked with an onshore licensed bank (BSP or BRED) under an ISDA 2002 FX master or bank master agreement; the primary onshore instrument for hedging the ODC's USD-revenue versus VUV-payroll mismatch.

VUV non-deliverable forward (NDF) against USD, transacted with a licensed offshore counterparty and settled in USD, permissible where the offshore parent or a foreign client needs to hedge VUV exposure without touching the onshore VUV market.

Cross-currency basis swap (USD/VUV) available only for large notional tickets (above USD 2,000,000 equivalent) and subject to bank credit and collateral approval; not actively quoted in the onshore market and therefore classified as conditional-permissible.

Tom-next and spot FX conversion of operational receipts with a 0.5-1.0% bank spread, executed as standing monthly instructions to convert only the budgeted VUV payroll amount, leaving USD invoice balances intact to create a natural hedge.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company annual registration renewal and VFSC annual government fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of the date of incorporation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs an administrative penalty of 10% of the unpaid annual fee plus a VT 10,000 late-payment fee; if payment remains overdue for 90 days, the Registrar may serve a strike-off notice and dissolve the company.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. International Companies are statutorily exempt from independent audit; no revenue, asset, or employee threshold creates a mandatory audit requirement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is imposed on International Companies. IFRS may be adopted voluntarily if financial statements are prepared, but there is no local GAAP requirement for exempt offshore entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: International Companies are not required to file an annual UBO return. The licensed registered agent must maintain a current beneficial ownership register, refresh the information annually or upon any trigger event (e.g., share transfer or change of beneficial owner), and make it available to the VFSC on demand.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit required; voluntary certified audit if procured: USD 3,500 - USD 12,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax. International Companies are wholly outside the Vanuatu income tax base by statute.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective tax rate regime for International Companies: nil corporate income tax, nil capital gains tax, nil payroll tax, nil branch profits tax, and nil dividend, interest, or royalty withholding tax for non-residents.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return & Renewal Filing (International Companies Act, Cap. 222, s. 98) lodged through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) electronic registry.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation or re-registration; the annual government renewal fee is payable on or before each anniversary date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal company name and VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; no Vanuatu tax identification number is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office physical address within Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the address of the licensed VFSC registered agent; a non-resident cannot maintain a statutory registered office directly.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Resident agent details and licensed agent endorsement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must be a VFSC-licensed resident agent; non-resident director and shareholder signatures must be notarized or apostilled.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital and classes of shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State share capital in Vatu; bearer shares are prohibited; ultimate beneficial ownership details must be disclosed to the resident agent for AML purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register of directors and shareholders summary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and shareholders are permitted; copies of passports and proof of address are required; nominee directors must declare their nominee capacity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of offshore status confirming no local business conducted in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm exemption from VAT and business license requirements; describe offshore software development services as supplied wholly outside Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of continuing compliance with AML/CFT and economic substance obligations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident operator must sign the declaration and provide updated substance answers if the company performs geographically mobile activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal surcharge accrues on a daily basis (typically VUV 500–2,000 per day) after the anniversary; prolonged non-payment triggers suspension of the certificate, automatic striking-off after approximately 6 months, a restoration fee, and monetary penalties against the company and each director.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Economic Substance Declaration submitted via the VFSC online portal under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Amendment Act 2020 and associated Financial Services Commission rules.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 12 months after the end of the fiscal year (default fiscal year ending 31 December) or within the VFSC-directed anniversary filing window.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of the company, VFSC registration number, and incorporation date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify the International Company by registration number; non-resident beneficial owners must be listed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classification of relevant activity from the geographically mobile activity list.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offshore software engineering and dedicated offshore development center services must be classified as a service or development hub activity; a full schedule of income streams is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial statements and gross income by income category.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Financial statements are not filed with Vanuatu authorities but must be available in-country; non-resident accountant-prepared statements are acceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical office, premises, and equipment description.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A leased serviced office or licensed agent premises with dedicated infrastructure is sufficient; virtual-only arrangements constitute a compliance red flag.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Employee headcount, payroll, and time commitment details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the number of locally engaged engineers and administrators; expatriate offshore staff require work permits and social security registration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Board meeting location and management control details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that strategic direction and key decisions are made in Vanuatu; remote attendance by non-resident directors is permitted but a quorum must be physically present.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Monetary penalties of up to VUV 50,000,000 for the company and up to VUV 10,000,000 plus imprisonment of up to 10 years for each director or officer for false declarations or persistent non-compliance, in addition to forced deregistration.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no dividend withholding tax; distributions from an International Company to non-resident shareholders are paid free of any Vanuatu tax or reporting obligation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable and not available: Vanuatu maintains no functioning comprehensive double taxation agreement network and imposes no domestic withholding tax, so no formal treaty-relief claim, tax residence certificate, or reclaim pathway exists. Where a foreign tax authority demands evidence of Vanuatu tax status, the International Company applies to VFSC for a Certificate of Tax Exemption or Certificate of Status; the certificate must be apostilled under the Hague Convention and may require legalization before recognition abroad.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate is 0% for both IP royalties and debt interest paid to non-residents; no concessional treaty rates are relevant because the domestic rate is nil. Foreign payers must nevertheless apply beneficial ownership and source rules of their own jurisdiction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no transfer pricing statute, no Local File or Master File thresholds, and no country-by-country reporting obligations; OECD-aligned transfer pricing documentation may nevertheless be required by the customer's or parent company's foreign tax jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The International Companies (Economic Substance) Amendment Act 2020 requires an International Company carrying on geographically mobile activities, including digital and software services hubs, to demonstrate credible substance in Vanuatu: physical premises, adequate qualified employees, locally controlled board or management, and expenditure proportional to income. Failure to satisfy or to file the annual economic substance declaration subjects the company and directors to penalties, deregistration, and adverse EU or OECD listing consequences affecting international bankability.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the VU_IC as a pure revenue-shifting conduit: booking license or development fees to Vanuatu while actual engineering, decision-making, and risk-taking occur in the customer's or parent's jurisdiction with intent to evade foreign corporate income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu Proceeds of Crime Act (as amended) and the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act, the VFSC may freeze assets, cancel the certificate, and compel restitution; foreign tax judgments may be enforced via Letters of Request. Monetary penalties reach VUV 50,000,000 plus forfeiture of all correlated funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts pierce the corporate veil where the International Company is a mere facade; directors and beneficial owners face civil restitution suits, travel bans under departure prohibition provisions, and custodial sentences of up to 15 years for money laundering or fraudulent evasion offenses.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company — Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining nominee-only directorship, no employees, no physical premises, no board minutes, and no commercial rationale while invoicing substantial offshore development revenue through VU_IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of the Economic Substance Amendment Act 2020 attracts tiered administrative penalties of up to VUV 50,000,000, forced deregistration of the International Company, and disqualification from re-registration, in addition to EU or OECD blacklisting consequences that destroy correspondent banking access.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors are personally liable for uncollectable company obligations where the veil is pierced; VFSC may impose a bar on acting as an officer for up to 10 years and issue an international travel-ban notice pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain adequate beneficial ownership records, client due diligence files, or suspicious transaction reports; accepting funds through unvetted payment rails without documented source of funds; or using nominee arrangements that conceal the principal.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Non-compliance with the Vanuatu AML/CFT framework (Anti-Money Laundering Act 2020 and FIU directives) triggers monetary penalties of VUV 1,000,000 to VUV 100,000,000 against the company and its resident agent, plus immediate suspension of the VFSC license and account freezing orders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director commits an offense of strict liability; upon conviction, personal fines of up to VUV 10,000,000, confiscation of personal assets under proceeds-of-crime orders, travel bans, and imprisonment of up to 15 years apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Trading and Misrepresentation to Creditors
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing invoices or contracts through VU_IC without genuine capability of performance, misrepresenting the Vanuatu tax-exempt status as a tax-dodging advantage, or trading while knowingly insolvent with intent to defraud creditors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act and general directors' duties, the VFSC may impose disqualification orders, compulsory winding-up, and criminal fines of VUV 2,000,000 per offense; contracts procured by fraud are void and all consideration must be restituted.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors incur personal civil liability to creditors for the full value of fraudulent transactions, forfeiture of personal tax exemptions, and a maximum criminal term of 12 years for fraudulent trading; charging orders and travel bans are routinely imposed.
